facts.value: A module examination performance is considered 'insufficient' (5.0) if a student misses an examination appointment without valid reason or interrupts participation before completion. This also applies if a written examination performance is not submitted within the allotted time, if only a blank paper is submitted in a written examination, or if the student remains silent in an oral examination.

The reason for absence or withdrawal must be reported in writing to the chair of the examination board immediately after becoming aware of it. A health condition that arises during an examination must be reported immediately to the examiner or examination supervision.

facts.value: In case of illness, a medical certificate and a certificate of examination incapacity must be submitted within three working days, stating which type of examination (written examination, oral examination, long-term examinations, other examination forms) the examination incapacity applies to for the respective examination date.
